# HTML adapter source dependencies

The private source-container build explicitly provisions Debian/Chromium/Python only for retained analysis fixtures; it does not redistribute them in the SDK. Its image retains package versions, engine/file hashes and installed OS notices. Complete redistribution, security and per-RID review remains pending. The task-local syscall analysis policy derives from external source blob `6e5e47e242892aaa290f916ba1045f9213ef0b84` under Apache-2.0 (license blob `d645695673349e3947e8e5ae42332d0ac3164cd7`). The explicit preparation tool verifies the original digest/license and retains both inputs, exact diff, modification notices, hashes and limitations outside Git. No production policy approval is implied. Local original process-peer compilation used a separately pinned task-local Zig 0.17.0 tool with its retained MIT license; hosted source builds use the runner's existing C toolchain. Independent PNG/PDF fixture observers explicitly use Pillow 12.3.0 and pypdf 6.10.0 outside the SDK dependency graph.

The original managed DevTools adapter uses pinned System.Text.Json 10.0.13 and its locked framework-specific dependencies. Package digests and original/LF-normalized notice digests are recorded in components.json. Microsoft MIT notice text is shared with the existing repository notice inventory. No Chromium, Node.js, font or host binary is redistributed by the SDK adapter. Source fixture binaries are explicitly caller-provisioned and separately pinned. Complete release SBOM, notices, security/licensing review, engine/host adoption and final-package qualification remain mandatory.
